scripts.backend:setup: cd backend && pnpm install && pnpm prisma migrate deploy --preview-feature && pnpm prisma generate && pnpm run dev
scripts.backend:reset: cd backend && pnpm install && pnpm prisma migrate reset --force --preview-feature && pnpm prisma generate && pnpm prisma db seed && pnpm run dev
scripts.frontend:setup: cd frontend && npm install && npm run dev
scripts.start:all: concurrently "npm run docker:up" "npm run backend:setup" "npm run frontend:setup"
scripts.reset:all: concurrently "npm run docker:up" "npm run backend:reset" "npm run frontend:setup"
